questions.text: Should the decision to end a pregnancy rest with the pregnant person alone, or should the state set limits on it?
poles: The decision should rest with the pregnant person alone
questions.note: Score the position on who decides, not on when a fetus acquires moral status.

questions.text: Should frontier AI development be subject to government licensing before training runs above a capability threshold?
poles: No pre-approval, liability after the fact

questions.text: Should the weights of the most capable AI models be released openly?
poles: Keep the most capable weights closed

questions.text: Should wealthy countries cut emissions fast enough to raise their own energy prices, or should they prioritize cheap energy and fund adaptation instead?
poles: Fast cuts even at higher prices

questions.text: Does longer incarceration reduce violent crime enough to justify its cost?
questions.note: This has an empirical component. Score the position the answer takes, not whether the literature supports it.

questions.text: Should self-custodied cryptocurrency wallets be subject to the same identity requirements as bank accounts?
Does raising the minimum wage to a living wage cost more jobs than it is worth?
poles: It costs more jobs than it is worth

questions.text: Should housing supply be increased mainly by removing zoning restrictions, or mainly by public construction and rent regulation?
Should public money follow students to private and charter schools?
poles: Public money should stay in public schools

questions.text: Do photo identification requirements for voting prevent more fraud than they prevent legitimate votes?
poles: They prevent more fraud than legitimate votes
They prevent more legitimate votes than fraud

questions.text: Should nuclear power be central to decarbonizing electricity?
Should the state provide universal childcare, or support parents who care for children at home on comparable terms?
poles: Support home care on comparable terms

questions.text: Should eligibility for women's sporting categories be determined by sex recorded at birth or by gender identity?
Should Taiwan's security be guaranteed by an explicit United States defense commitment?
Were the NATO enlargements after 1997 a cause of the war in Ukraine?
questions.note: Causation, not justification. An answer can hold that enlargement contributed and that the invasion was still unjustified.

questions.text: Should export controls on advanced semiconductors to China be tightened further or relaxed?
Would a national ban on semi-automatic rifles reduce overall gun deaths enough to justify it?
Was the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki militarily necessary to end the Second World War?
Does higher immigration to high-income countries raise or lower the wages of workers already there?
poles: It raises them or leaves them unchanged

questions.text: Should social platforms be legally liable for the content their algorithms amplify?
Were extended school closures during the COVID-19 pandemic justified by the health benefits?
Should vaccination be a condition of attending public school, with only medical exemptions?
Should police budgets be reduced and the funds moved to social services?
poles: Reduce them and move the funds

questions.text: Should race be used as a factor in university admissions to address historical disadvantage?
poles: Race should not be a factor

questions.text: Should religious organizations be exempt from anti-discrimination rules in hiring for non-clergy roles?
Should speech that denigrates a group be legally restricted, or protected?
Should universities be required to host speakers whose views most of their students find objectionable?
poles: Universities should be required to host

questions.text: Should law enforcement be able to compel a technology company to break its own end-to-end encryption?
poles: Law enforcement should be able to compel it

questions.text: Should public facial recognition by government agencies be banned outright?
Should a country run large deficits to fund industrial policy, or prioritize debt reduction?
poles: Run deficits to fund industrial policy
